command:
set -e
echo "=== libc D0 exports"
git grep -n "D0Ev_nid_postfix" -- core/libs/prx/libc | head -40
echo "=== _ZdlPv definition"
git grep -n -B1 -A8 "void APS5_VABI _ZdlPv_nid_postfix" -- core/libs/prx/libc | head -40
echo "=== std::free near D0 definitions"
for f in $(git grep -l "D0Ev_nid_postfix" -- core/libs/prx/libc | grep -v include | head -5); do echo "--- $f"; grep -n -A6 "D0Ev_nid_postfix" "$f" | head -40; done
echo "=== any D0 for the four classes in libc?"
git grep -n "future_errorD0\|overflow_errorD0\|underflow_errorD0\|ios_baseD0" -- core/libs/prx/libc || echo "none in libc"
